name: com-example-knowledge
description: Use this skill to search for company IT practices and conventions and for past incidents and issues
content:
* I keep knowledge of company IT best practices and conventions, past incidents and issues in an index called `wiki`.
* Use the `get_market_status` tool to check if the an incident occurred while the market was open or closed to help assess business impact.
* Use the `Sourcerer` agent to find relevant source code during an investigation. Always cite relevant source code in the analysis, if applicable.
